Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/capability_policy.py

src/agent_runtime/capability_policy.py

Python · Tier A

Compile explicit capability selections into deterministic run envelopes.

Responsibilities

  • Validate canonical skill/tool/executable identifiers and resolve enabled, preferred and excluded sets.

Boundaries

  • Capability selection is distinct from permission to mutate a target. Executable name restrictions do not classify the semantic effects of a command.

Lifecycle

  • Ingress resolves prompt/conversation/global selection; apply_policy intersects prior scope and writes allowed and initial-tool fields for run initialization.

State

  • Product defaults select Agent Introspection, Docs, Email, File, Gateway, KV, Memory, Python and Shell. Identity, Task Context, KV, Memory and Shell form the built-in baseline. @use_memory controls automatic Memory recall and guidance, not tool access. Saved selections retain other choices. Legacy opt-out upgrades omit skills marked default_enabled false.

Security

  • References and preferences cannot expand a pre-existing operational envelope. Local identity, task-context and KV tools are always available. Large preferred skills initially advertise only entry tools.

Collaborators

  • registry.py supplies identities without copying exhaustive schemas; native/state.py binds policy; native/catalog.py applies the resulting exposure scope.

Public surface

  • normalize_policy rejects unknown/conflicting identifiers; effective_policy selects precedence; apply_policy compiles current context fields.

executable_basename 90 @brief Validate a plain executable name or path, reject shell syntax and option-like names, and return its basename.
AgentCapabilityPolicy 103 @brief Define the version-one skill/tool selection and shell preferences, with agent/docs/email/file/gateway/kv/memory/python/shell as product defaults; baseline skills cannot be excluded.
AgentCapabilityPolicy.exact_version 122 @brief Require the integer schema version 1, rejecting booleans and coerced versions.
AgentCapabilityPolicy.canonical_lists 132 @brief Deduplicate and sort policy identities, normalize shell basenames and reject preferred/excluded overlap.
normalize_policy 157 @brief Revalidate a policy against registered identities and reject contradictory skill/tool choices; omitted defaults are limited to skills actually registered.
resolve_effective_capability_policy 204 Narrower scopes replace the complete snapshot; {} selects product defaults. Resolution never merges user scopes or changes workflow/Gateway ceilings. Call at acceptance, then retain the compiled snapshot for the run's lifetime.
effective_policy 225 @brief Return the validated complete snapshot selected by prompt, conversation, global or default precedence.
compile_capability_ceiling 235 Pure v1 compiler. Neither registry growth nor a selector grants authority.
apply_policy 267 Intersect workflow restrictions for optional capabilities; retain core internal tools. This is idempotent so API validation and non-UI RuntimeHost entry share it. No availability probing or inference is needed for compilation.
policy_task_guidance 314 @brief Project selection preferences as model guidance without publishing deterministic exclusion fences or repeating enabled inventories.
